questions.text: Explain the construction and working of LVDT for the measurement of displacement. The output of LVDT is connected to 5V voltmeter through an amplifier whose amplification factor is 250. An output of 2mV appears across the terminals of LVDT when the core moves through the distance of 0.5mm. Calculate the sensitivity of LVDT and that of the whole setup. The milli voltmeter scale has 100 divisions. The scale can be read to 1/5 of a division. Calculate the resolution of the instrument in mm.

A linear resistance potentiometer is 50 mm long and is uniformly wound with a wire of total resistance 5,000 $\Omega$. Under normal condition, the slider is at the center of the potentiometer. Determine the linear displacement when the resistance of the POT as measured by a Wheatstone bridge is 1850 $\Omega$. If it is possible to measure a minimum value of 5 $\Omega$ resistance with the above arrangement, determine the resolution of the POT in mm.

A rotary potentiometer has a total resistance of $5\text{ k}\Omega$, a total angular displacement of $300^\circ$. If the wiper is at $120^\circ$ and applied voltage is 10 V, what is the resistance between the wiper and the starting end? Also find output voltage.
Define errors and list out its types. Analyze the significance of accuracy vs. precision in different measurement scenarios. Can you have high precision but poor accuracy? Illustrate with an example.

Derive the expression for resistance using the ammeter-voltmeter method. Interpret the results of the ammeter-voltmeter method for measuring medium resistance. Discuss the impact of the internal resistance of the ammeter and voltmeter on the measured value of resistance.
What are the operation modes of 8255 PPI? Explain the block diagram of mode 1 input configuration and also write its control word and status word.
Draw the general block diagram of Atmega328 (AVR) CPU microcontroller. Briefly explain its features.
Explain interfacing of DC motor with ATmega328P microcontroller along with its circuit diagram and program.
What do you mean by WSN and how it is different from traditional sensors? Explain protocol stack diagram of ZIGBEE.
What are the major considerations while choosing right connectivity in instrumentation system? Explain SPI protocol with communication design of master slave configuration.
Explain the factors that should be considered while doing component placement. What factors will you consider while routing the signal traces on printed circuit board (PCB)?
Write an importance of decoupling, ground bounce, cross talk and impedance matching in designing circuit.
List out the steps for Software development life cycle (SDLC). Explain how prototype software development model is different from waterfall model.
Explain the working principle of Electrodynamometer type wattmeter with its mathematical expression of deflection for both AC and DC operations.
Explain the structural block diagram of smart sensor.
Define Industry 4.0. What might be the challenges to implement automation system in industrial instrumentation system?
